notes: Not an official PMPML feed: generated from the Apli-PMPML/Chartr API. First-stop trip times come from that API; times at intermediate stops are MODELLED by the generator (distance along shape / 20 km/h average speed, see gtfs_parallel.py), so ride durations are estimates. No frequencies/real-time. Stops outside the Pune bbox [73.3,18.4,74.0,18.8] dropped (1669 of 6746); stops within 15 m merged (542). Pune-area routes that leave the bbox keep only their in-bbox stops.

license: MIT-0 (MIT No Attribution), Copyright (c) 2026 Aayush Rai
notes: Not an official BEST feed (BEST publishes no open GTFS). Same author/toolchain as the PMPML feed; intermediate stop times are likely modelled the same way (not stated in the repo README - unverified). The 140 MB stop_times.txt covers BEST, TMT and KDMT; only agency_id BEST is imported; TMT/KDMT are not. Bbox [72.75,18.88,73.05,19.3]; 75 stops outside dropped, 483 merged within 15 m.
